answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports the objective because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though closed revenue and durability are omitted. Memories 31 and 86 show improvements in durable activation or time-to-value, but only through intermediate adoption metrics. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits discount economics, retention, customer quality, and durability. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first-action gains, without evidence of revenue quality, retention, or long-term sustainability.
